voice.rule: "the Firm" throughout (SKM142.2: the Firm 15, we 0); "you" only for the addressee in the reliance section.

defined_terms.pointer_formula: (Unless otherwise defined herein, all capitalised terms shall have the meanings ascribed thereto in the [●] dated [●] … (the [●]).)

cross_refs.rule: Section 4 (Assumptions), Section 5 (Qualifications), Annexure B (Authorisation Documents); limbs as "paragraphs (a) and (b) above".

heading.text: Dated: [●] / To, / The [●], / As Listed In Annexure A. / Dear Madam/Sir, / Subject: ⇥Legal Opinion On The [●]

introduction.text: Ali Khan Law Associates (the Firm) has acted as legal counsel to [●] in connection with the [●].

documents.text: For the purposes of this opinion (this Opinion), the Firm has examined: (a) …; (b) …; and (c) copies of the documents listed in Annexure B (Authorisation Documents) (… together, the Reviewed Documents).

opinion.text: On the basis of the Reviewed Documents, and subject to the assumptions in Section 4 (Assumptions) and the qualifications in Section 5 (Qualifications), the Firm is of the opinion that:

assumptions.text: For the purposes of this Opinion, the Firm has assumed, without independent verification: that all documents provided to the Firm are complete, all signatures, seals and stamps on them are genuine …;

qualifications.text: This Opinion is subject to the following qualifications: this Opinion is limited to the laws of Pakistan in force on its date. The Firm expresses no opinion on the laws of any other jurisdiction; … the term ‘enforceable’ means …; the Firm expresses no opinion on any matter of Islamic jurisprudence or Shariah; and …

reliance.text: This Opinion is addressed to [●] and may be relied upon by them only. / This Opinion speaks only as of its date … / This Opinion is given by the Firm, and no partner or employee of the Firm assumes any personal responsibility for it.

signature.text: For And On Behalf Of / Ali Khan Law Associates / ___________ / [signing partner] / [designation] / Ali Khan Law Associates

banned.reason: The firm's opinion has no complimentary close: the reliance section, then the signature block.
